::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 19th 1865  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library
:::

My dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd),
Thank you for your note. [Miss Sewell](people/person_1301.qmd) is coming here to talk the matter over, and sketch our plans next Wednesday week and then I will write again[^1]

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: These were plans for *Historical Selections*.
